entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,435 K and log g 4.9 (u1 0.163, u2 0.439): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
